title: Stellar Blade Complete Edition
summary: Stellar Blade Complete Edition comes to Switch 2 from SHIFT UP with a release date of November 5, 2026 and a price of $59.99. Unusually for a big third-party game, the physical version has the full game on the cartridge, not a Game-Key Card, so the box works without a download. The 25.4 GB size is from the pre-release listing and may change. The game outputs 60 FPS at 1080p on the TV and 720p in handheld mode, but the developer renders at 30 FPS and uses FSR 3.1 frame interpolation to double it. You can switch frame generation off if you prefer lower but genuine frame rates. With 17 languages, it has one of the widest language lists on the system.
